escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, late morning): the production table corner of the Efeonce studio, from a stool at the big oak worktable, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a matte dark-navy painted wall 2.5 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of that wall — «Hecho a mano» in large white letters with its orange sphere as the period, and «(casi)» added by hand beside it — reproduce it exactly: the letters as matte white paint with crisp stencil edges, the «(casi)» as real white chalk-marker handwriting with slightly uneven strokes. In the foreground the oak worktable carries real modelling-clay work: steel and wooden sculpting tools, a cutting mat, a few simple clay forms in off-white and navy (spheres, a half-shaped piece, a rolled coil of cobalt blue clay), no finished characters or icons; at the bottom RIGHT corner of the table, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid WHITE desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the table between 74% and 94% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), matte white finish, crisp bevel, like a finished piece among the work. LIGHT: hard low sun from the LEFT through a window out of frame crosses the haze as solid visible shafts and rakes across the table and the lettering; the centre of the navy wall stays calm in deep, detailed shade. TRACES OF WORK: a clay tool left mid-stroke on the half-shaped piece, a damp cloth folded on the table edge. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artwork from Image 2 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and fully legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
